papers.title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
papers.desc: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default component of modern diffusion systems, remains poorly understood.

papers.title: Sol-Attn: Accelerating Video Generation Inference via On-the-Fly Attention Sparsification
papers.desc: Diffusion transformers are essential for high-fidelity video generation, but long token sequences make attention a dominant inference bottleneck.

papers.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
papers.desc: Multi-turn long-horizon planning is critical for foundation model agents, yet how to fundamentally improve it remains unclear.

papers.title: Chamaileon: Cross-Context Binder Design with Contextualized Modeling and Mixed Sampling
papers.desc: The rapid evolution of generative models has unlocked new potentials in protein binder design, a pivotal task in structural biology, by facilitating end-to-end generation via joint sequence-structure modeling or hallucination.

papers.title: dRAE: Representation Autoencoder with Hyper-Spherical Codes
papers.desc: In this work, we aim to discretize the high-dimensional visual representations to bridge the gap with language models - a non-trivial challenge, as existing quantization methods suffer from codebook collapse, failing to scale while preserving semantic coherence.

papers.title: Reasoning Denoiser: Denoising Reasoning Traces for Hallucination Detection in Large Reasoning Models
papers.desc: Large reasoning models (LRMs) generate long reasoning traces before producing final answers.

papers.title: Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation
papers.desc: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability.

papers.title: Leveraging External Knowledge for Historical Document Restoration via Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
papers.desc: Historical documents act as invaluable knowledge archives but often suffer from illegibility due to physical deterioration and damage.

papers.title: A Vocabulary for Multi-Agent Automated Research Systems
papers.desc: We introduce a vocabulary for automated research systems built from one or more agents to make their design choices easier to describe and compare.

papers.title: TRACE: Business Rule-Grounded Reasoning Curriculum for Knowledge-Preserving Parametric Tool Retrieval in Enterprise LLMs
papers.desc: Parametric retrieval enables LLMs to retrieve tools implicitly by assigning each API a unique virtual token and training the model to generate it via constrained beam search.

papers.title: UltraViT: Latency-Optimized On-device Vision Encoder for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.desc: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) remain bottlenecked by massive computational footprints, precluding their deployment on resource-constrained edge devices.

papers.title: Characterizing Warp Divergence from Pascal to Blackwell
papers.desc: Since Volta introduced Independent Thread Scheduling (ITS), NVIDIA GPUs have been widely assumed to handle warp divergence in a fixed manner.

papers.title: Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels
papers.desc: Reliable visual document understanding requires a model to attribute each answer to the evidence regions that support it.

papers.title: IndicTalk: A Large-Scale Persona-Based Multilingual Conversational Corpus for Indic Languages
papers.desc: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed conversational AI, yet high-quality multilingual code-mixed dialogue resources remain scarce, particularly for Indic languages where speakers naturally alternate between English and their native language in both native-script and Romanized forms.

papers.title: WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling
papers.desc: Many recent robot policies pursue stronger control by using large pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) as the action backbone.
